europe_now.title: Czechia faces widespread protests over proposed public media funding cuts
europe_now.summary: Demonstrations are taking place across Czechia as citizens and media advocates rally against planned government funding reductions for public broadcasting networks. The legislative changes have sparked intense public backlash regarding the future independence and viability of national media institutions.

sources.headline: Czechia braces for massive protest against cuts to public media

europe_now.title: Tinder parent company penalized with multi-million euro privacy fine
europe_now.summary: The owner of the dating application Tinder has been issued an eleven million euro fine for violations of European data privacy regulations. Regulatory authorities concluded that the company failed to handle user data in compliance with strict regional privacy standards.

sources.headline: Tinder owner hit with €11M privacy fine

top_stories.title: Public opinion survey indicates strong European backing for a unified EU defense force
top_stories.summary: Recent survey findings show that a substantial majority of European citizens express support for the establishment of a joint European Union army. This growing public sentiment reflects evolving security perspectives across the continent amid ongoing regional conflicts.

sources.headline: European citizens overwhelmingly back creation of an EU army, survey finds

top_stories.title: Ukrainian refugees in Poland navigate the realities of long-term settlement
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian nationals living in Poland are increasingly transitioning from temporary displacement to establishing permanent long-term lives within the country. This shift presents new integration challenges and opportunities for both the refugee population and Polish host communities.

sources.headline: Temporary no longer: Ukrainian refugees in Poland confront the long term
